scripts.dev:tauri: pnpm runtime:prepare && pnpm --dir agent-bridge build && pnpm --dir apps/desktop dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:packages: pnpm runtime:prepare && pnpm --dir agent-bridge build && pnpm --dir apps/desktop build
scripts.test: pnpm test:runtime && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: pnpm --recursive --if-present run check && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
